conditions: Happy Monday, Jackson Hole. This is your last chance for the 25/26 season to start your week playing hooky on the slopes of Rendezvous Mountain. It looks like the day will start off with some high cloud cover, but that'll break up for you by the lunch bell. Clear skies expected in the afternoon with temperatures a couple of degrees warmer that what we saw over the weekend. Winds will be largely unremarkable. Proper spring skiing expected with mid-day high temps of 61 at the base while the summit will stick around the 40 degree mark. Enjoy! -OH
